description: Scans a local directory with Data Hogo's open-source security engine (300+ checks across JS/TS, Python, Go, Java, PHP, C#, mobile, Supabase). Runs entirely locally — nothing is uploaded anywhere. Returns a security score and the highest-severity findings. Call get_finding with a finding_id from the response to see full detail (description, fix) for a specific finding.

min_severity.description: Only include findings at or above this severity. Defaults to showing everything down to low.

path.description: Directory to scan, absolute or relative to the current working directory.

name: scan_project
title: Scan a local project for security issues
